report.explanation: The only evidence is a single trace pair for order POST /v1/orders: one 200 OK and one 503 error within the same minute, with p95 100ms. This is contradictory, low-volume telemetry that neither establishes a bounded root cause nor rules out alternatives. No deployment, memory, or additional service facts are available. Handing off for more evidence.
missing_evidence: Error rate and status distribution for order POST /v1/orders over a wider window to confirm whether 503s are sustained or isolated
Downstream dependency traces/logs for the failing order request to locate the 503 origin
Deployment records for order service around the incident window
Resource saturation metrics (CPU, memory, connections) for order service
